findings.description: The CMK is created without `enable_key_rotation = true`, so the key material is never automatically rotated. A single long-lived key encrypts all log bucket data indefinitely, extending the window in which a compromised or cryptanalytically weakened key remains valid and increasing the volume of ciphertext exposed under one key.
